description.value:
Once belonged to a soldier of Aidonia, this helmet is crafted from the tanned mane of a direwolf. Its fearsome appearance alone is enough to sap the will of enemies who fear death.
Warriors who wore this helmet crept onto the battlefield like wild grass, and vanished like morning dew.

"The living shall one day join the dead. The bridge across the Styx knows no order." — Aidonia

D&D 5e Effect

As an action, consume this item and choose the creatures in your Main Party who can see you. The benefit begins when the next combat starts and lasts for 1 minute. Temporary hit points gained increase by proficiency bonus, and the creature has +1 AC while it has temporary hit points. A creature can benefit from only one synthesized pre-combat consumable at a time; a new one replaces the previous one.

GM Description — Original HSR Effect

Upon use, all allies gain 18% increased Shield Effect for the next battle.
